title: Using Aura AI to make a game
author: Just_Recover_5765
selftext:
Hey guys, first time making any kind of game and have no idea what I'm doing and I'm so glad I found aura. 

So I'm a musician with an obsession with fantasy and orchestral music but haven't been able to get my music into much, games or short films, leaving me unfulfilled. So I thought why not make my own game and music and sound FX. 

I've been pretty low for months but this has sparked something in me and I'm having fun. 

If you have no idea what you're doing but want to create a game, I recommend trying out their 2 week trial.

I'm not advertising for Aura, I'm just excited I found it
